[[Large Skull]]s are {{rarity|Rare|rare}} [[Crafting material#Advanced crafting materials|advanced crafting materials]] dropped by [[grawl]]. They are primarily used for crafting [[Godskull weapons]] and the [[Wolf Statue (exotic)|Wolf Statue]] for [[Howl]], as well as several [[upgrade component]]s and the [[Relic of the Centaur]].
